page: UpCloud GPU-16xCPU-192GB-3xL4 is a GPU-accelerated cloud server configured with 16 vCPUs on the x86_64 architecture and 192.0 GB of system memory. The server is deployed on the KVM hypervisor and features a shared CPU allocation model. It is equipped with three NVIDIA L4 GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, providing a total of 72 GB of VRAM.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning external block storage must be attached for persistent data. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the combination of a shared CPU allocation with high-density system memory and triple GPU accelerators offers a specialized resource profile, balancing compute cost with high-capacity VRAM and system memory.

The server is designed for workloads requiring significant parallel processing capabilities and substantial memory capacity. Suitable use cases include machine learning inference, data science tasks, video transcoding, and graphics rendering pipelines that benefit from multi-GPU setups but do not require dedicated CPU cores.
